text:
rachel: starting a staged rollout for inference v2.4 -> 5% eu-central1 + 5% us-east1. change-window open until 20:00 UTC. tagging ops for stop/go.

deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v2.4 -> 5% in eu-central1, us-east1. canary_id=cb-1849994322. notify: @devops @anil.

devops: quick FYI: autoscaler config for us-east1 has a cooldown of 30s; if we see spike it may spin instances slower than expected.

rachel: noted. we expect steady traffic. continue monitoring for p99 and error_rate.

anil: seeing a small uptick in inference time in us-east1 p95 -> +40ms at ~19:03 UTC. no errors. linking trace: https://traces/redwood/trace/1849994322

kate: QA ran 500 regression prompts against v2.4 in eu-central — 3 diffs marked as flaky but nothing blocking. sending diffs to models channel.

zane: deploy-bot flags: ephemeral memory pressure on nodes in eu-central1, GC spikes at 19:05. might correlate with a new tokenization cache.

rachel: okay, propose we hold eu-central and keep us-east at 5% until we validate memory pattern. thoughts?

priyanka: vote -> hold eu-central, continue us-east. we can push a hotfix to reduce cache retention in v2.4 if needed.

anil: +1 to hold eu-central. meanwhile we should pin eu-central routing to v2.3 to avoid customer impact.

devops: applying routing override: eu-central1 -> pinned v2.3 now.

deploy-bot: route-override applied: eu-central1 pinned to v2.3. canary cb-1849994322 status: REGION_HOLD. log id: route-ov-1849994322-ec.

rachel: thanks. can a devops person capture heapdumps and core metrics for the gc spikes?

devops: collecting heapdumps and uploading to /incidents/cb-1849994322. ETA 20m.

kate: updating release notes: marking v2.4 as "beta token-cache" with known GC sensitivity in eu-central. will add mitigation steps.

rachel: set a hard resume check in 45m. if memory stabilizes we can resume eu-central to 10% then proceed.

priyanka: adding a customer-facing blurb to the incident board: "small regional hold while we validate memory behavior". low impact.

zane: running synthetic warmup with 2k requests against a private v2.4 instance to reproduce GC. posting results here in 15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled: resume-check at 1849997022. watchers: rachel, devops, priyanka.

rachel: thanks everyone. final note: no rollback yet, this is a regional hold to limit blast radius. will follow-up with CI diffs and postmortem if needed.
